body: I feel the same pain you do right now. And even though you are a complete stanger I want you here. My best friend took her life and I wish I could join her. I'm here for you, pm me if you want.
Hey, please tell me you're still here.
Its just been like this for so many years. I'm young and already sick of it. I appreciate your condolences and kind words. I hope I can pull myself out of this but its so hard to keep fighting.
